text:
rita_sales: Hi team — had to rebook a flight after the client pushed the kickoff. Paid a $162.00 change fee on my personal card. Can finance reimburse?

jamie_finance: Please attach the e-receipt and original itinerary. Note reimbursable if change was client-driven or company-requested; otherwise may be out of policy. Policy link: https://intranet.redwood.example/policies/travel.

owen_travel: Travel ops confirms the client rescheduled and Rita switched to an earlier flight to keep the briefing on schedule. Marked as client-driven in our notes.

rita_sales: Dropped the receipt here: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1802001234-changefee.jpg — shows Skylark Airways charge $162.00 and booking ref ZXY789. Original ticket was for 6/15 moved to 6/16 by client.

lisa_mgr: Confirming — Rita was required to attend earlier call. Approving reimbursement. Approved for reimbursement to card. :thumbsup:

jamie_finance: Thanks Lisa. Rita, submit in Ramp: Expense type = Travel -> Flight change fee, tag = project-aurora, attach receipt. For amounts between $150-$200 we need manager sign-off (we have it) and finance will code to GL 6402.

rita_sales: Submitted in Ramp, expense RMP-22001. Requested reimburse to card.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-22001 created and forwarded to Finance. Estimated processing: next payroll.

finance-bot: Expense RMP-22001 validated. GL account set to 6402. Processing scheduled for payroll run on 2026-07-01.

jamie_finance: All set. If you prefer ACH instead of card, reply here with "ACH" plus last 4 of account; otherwise we'll reimburse to the card on file.

rita_sales: Card is fine, thanks everyone.

jamie_finance: Closing thread — reimbursement approved and queued. :white_check_mark:
